children.value: > Fact From Story Flexport is in talks to acquire the technology of Convoy, the once buzzy digital freight startup that abruptly shuttered after failing to find a buyer.
> > Fact From Story If Flexport acquires the technology, the company plans to restore Convoy’s trucking services for as many customers and partners as possible, according to WSJ’s source.
> > > Fact From Story Flexport founder Ryan Petersen just took back the CEO title after his hand-picked successor was pushed out.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A CEO taking back their title suggests a desire to steer the company's direction.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Acquiring technology can enable a company to restore services previously offered by the technology's original owner.
> Commonsense Knowledge If a company is in talks to acquire something, they are considering acquiring it.
